correctness.rationale: Use the barycentric subdivision: whole strict flags are simplices, with their vertex order given by increasing face cardinality. The group preserves cardinalities, so stabilizers fix cells pointwise and the quotient cellular differential is the signed whole-flag deletion formula, not a simplicial complex of separate face orbits. The independent reconstruction tests indegree and underlying forest, builds flags by submask recursion, checks both consecutive boundary products, and gives integral Smith ranks (26,180,245) for quotient cell counts (27,206,425,250), with all nonzero Smith factors units. Hence the images are primitive and the quotient has H0=Z, H3=Z^5 and no other homology. A direct fundamental-group check contracts a spanning tree, then uses triangular relations with exactly one surviving edge generator until all 206 edges give trivial elements. This independently verifies the simple connectivity established in the frozen proof by shellability of the labeled complex and Armstrong's fixed-point criterion. Since H2 vanishes, Hurewicz gives pi2=0 and identifies pi3 with H3; representing an integral basis by sphere maps and using homological Whitehead proves the wedge. For S5 the analogous check gives cell counts (19,121,226,125), Smith ranks (18,103,123), all nonzero factors units, and all 121 edge generators trivial. Its quotient is therefore a wedge of two 3-spheres. On rational chains the residual involution's coinvariants compute that further quotient, and averaging identifies them with invariants, so the plus and minus eigenspaces have dimensions two and three.
residual_risks: The wedge equivalence is a homotopy statement, not an explicit collapse or homeomorphism. The eigenspace splitting is stated over Q; this does not identify a split integral module.
